description: Free. Resolve a station or city name to a stop_id. A bare city name resolves to that city's main rail hub only when exactly one candidate exists; the answer then carries a 'resolution' object naming the rule, the chosen station and the rejected alternatives. Use the returned stop_id as 'to' in plan_transfer.

q.description: Station or city name, e.g. 'Leipzig Hbf'.

name: search_stations
